text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Stack: frozen model with the 14-day correction and spread factor 1.15. Every other arm has the spread factor and, unless named, no correction. 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026 (the runs that experiment 34 left out). Dot: estimate. Line: 99.44% interval from re-drawing whole months. Zero: same score. Grey band: plus or minus 0.05, the no-change band for solar and wind.'
text.tspan: Stack: frozen model with the 14-day correction and spread factor 1.15. Every other arm has
the spread factor and, unless named, no correction. 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to
June 2026 (the runs that experiment 34 left out).
Dot: estimate. Line: 99.44% interval from re-drawing whole months. Zero: same score. Grey
band: plus or minus 0.05, the no-change band for solar and wind.
